prompt:
Goal: Create a clean anime character reference sheet in a loose hand-drawn concept-art style for an elegant androgynous swordsman.

Canvas: Wide horizontal white background, high-resolution, no scenery, no title text, no labels, plenty of negative space. Use thin sketchy ink lines, slightly rough edges, flat cel shading, restrained painterly texture, and a polished Japanese fantasy game character-design aesthetic.

Layout: Show exactly 6 discrete character views arranged across the canvas: 1 full-body front view on the far left, 1 full-body three-quarter front view beside it, 1 full-body right side profile in the center, 1 full-body back view slightly right of center, 1 large bust portrait facing forward in the upper right, and 1 large head-and-shoulders side-profile portrait in the lower right. Keep proportions consistent across all views.

Subject details: The character is a slim young adult with pale skin, sharp golden amber eyes, a calm serious expression, and very long layered deep navy blue hair with messy bangs, side locks, and a long flowing back section reaching past the waist. Add long red dangling earrings visible on both portraits and front views. The face is refined and slightly melancholic, with narrow eyes and a small mouth.

Costume: Design an ornate East Asian-inspired fantasy outfit in white, black, antique gold, and deep red. Include a high black collar with gold knot-like ornamentation, structured black-and-gold shoulder armor with filigree cutouts, wide white sleeves, black gloves, layered black trousers, fitted black boots with gold trim, a long white outer robe or coat with elaborate gold cloud-and-scroll patterns, black inner panels, red lining, and multiple red tassels and cords around the waist and shoulders. Add a prominent red knotted waist ornament with hanging tassels and gold details. The back view should clearly show the long white coat panels with symmetrical gold embroidery and the character’s long hair falling down the back.

Style constraints: Keep the sheet clean and model-sheet focused, with no weapons, no props, no background objects, no decorative frame, and no text. Maintain accurate costume continuity between all 6 views, emphasize the ornate gold embroidery and red tassel accents, and make the image feel like a production-ready hand-drawn character turnaround for animation or game development.
